subtitle: Dig Discover Restore Exhibit
promotional_text: Fossil Hall: excavate fossils, restore ancient skeletons, build your museum, and become a paleontologist on an archaeological adventure.
description: Fossil Hall is an immersive archaeological adventure game that takes you on a journey through time. As a skilled archaeologist, travel to dig sites around the world to excavate dinosaur fossils, carefully restore ancient skeletons, conduct scientific research, and build an impressive museum to showcase your discoveries. Features: excavation through rock layers on a strategic grid, fossil parts from 52+ dinosaur species, your own dinosaur museum, a research lab for diet, DNA, habitat, and behavior, tool upgrades for brush, pickaxe, drill, and scanner, 52 support cards, dig sites from forests to volcanoes across geological eras, and real dinosaur facts. Suited to adventure, simulation, and educational play for all ages.
app_review_notes: Fossil Hall is an offline archaeological adventure game. Players excavate fossils by tapping blocks in a grid, collect dinosaur parts, upgrade tools, and build a museum. No sign-in required. Educational content about real dinosaurs is included.
